annotations.text:
Trip planner flow — festival → your trip → draft schedule → content chooser.
One visual system, lifted from the current planner: Plus Jakarta Sans + Inter, violet accent, 16px radii. Each festival keeps its own colour on every screen (Fringe violet, International Festival teal, Book/Tattoo amber & blue).

The draft is the product. Every block is a proposal; the popover is the whole correction vocabulary for a repeating show (time / show / genre / venue). A one-off event only offers Not interested. Starred = gold ring, never swapped.

The existing grid survives as the content chooser, one step deeper. Grouped by origin, all of it visible behind Show 20 more; starred rows pinned at the top of their group. The Best for your trip sort is a later feature — A–Z / By time keep the plain catalogue.
